title: Coreset 样本 Loss 分析

standard.summary: 记录真实训练微批次的逐样本主损失，仅用于分析，不改变采样、权重或数据文件。
standard.effect: 在输出目录生成 coreset_report_epochN.json / .csv，结束时写 final 报告。JSON 包含覆盖统计和噪声区间；CSV 可直接用表格工具打开。
standard.whenToUse: 需要检查哪些样本反复出现较高损失、观测是否充分时。优先在相同噪声区间比较。
standard.avoidWhen: 高 loss 或高波动并不等于坏图。未接入逐样本损失的路线会记录 missing_loss，不能把空报告视为正常覆盖。 coverage 中 microbatches/missing_loss 按微批次计数，其余按样本观测计数。

standard_en.summary: Observe per-sample base diffusion loss in completed training microbatches, without changing sampling, weights or dataset files.
standard_en.effect: JSON/CSV reports are written beside training outputs at epoch intervals and completion.
standard_en.whenToUse: Inspect sample coverage and loss within comparable noise bands.
standard_en.avoidWhen: High loss or variance does not establish poor image quality; inspect missing_loss and missing_identity coverage.

advanced.principle: 记录模型主损失在空间约简后、最终样本加权前的逐样本值；可能已含该模型的固有权重和空间掩码/权重。只在同一路线、损失设置及噪声区间内比较。标准差是观测离散程度，不是置信区间。
advanced.intervention: 不开启旧 easy/hard/toxic 分类或加权采样。训练调用成功后记账，后续优化器跳步不撤销观测。验证和闭包重算不记账。
advanced.expectedImpact: 不增加模型前向。开启后每微批有一次小向量 CPU 传输，整步 CUDA Graph 回放会使用现有 eager 路径以确保观测有效。
advanced.tradeoffs: 统计随 companion checkpoint 恢复；旧 checkpoint 无历史则从零开始并提示。多卡报告按 rank 分开，不冒充全数据统计。

advanced_en.principle: Route-defined per-sample main loss after spatial reduction and before final sample weighting; intrinsic model and spatial weights may already be applied. Compare within the same route, loss settings and noise band. Standard deviation is dispersion, not a confidence interval.
advanced_en.intervention: No automatic classification, sample weighting or removal.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No additional forward pass; one small CPU transfer per microbatch. Full-step CUDA Graph replay falls back to the eager route for observations.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: History resumes with companion checkpoints; older checkpoints start new history. Distributed reports are rank-local.
